title: Model Evaluation, Validation, and Reliability
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in Model Evaluation, Validation, and Reliability and connect the numbered lesson topics.
Apply a representative technique or model the decision process using a transparent example.
Describe evaluation needs, assumptions, and risks relevant to the module.

overview_visual.alt_text: Two-column lesson roadmap for Module 9: Model Evaluation, Validation, and Reliability. It lists 10 curriculum topics and ends with the workflow Observe, Experiment, Evaluate, Iterate.
overview_visual.caption: Module 9 visual roadmap: scan the ordered lesson cards, then use the Observe → Experiment → Evaluate → Iterate cycle when applying the concepts.

notes: All 10 lesson titles and their source subtopics are preserved from the AI.pdf syllabus. Evaluation is part of system design, not an afterthought. A metric is useful only when it reflects the goal, data conditions, and error costs. The module is draft pending subject-matter review.
